name: SK_ID_PREV
details: ID of previous credit in Home credit related to loan in our sample. (One loan in our sample can have 0,1,2 or more previous loan applications in Home Credit, previous application could, but not necessarily have to lead to credit) [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: SK_ID_CURR
details: ID of loan in our sample [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE
details: Contract product type (Cash loan, consumer loan [POS] ,...) of the previous application

name: AMT_ANNUITY
details: Annuity of previous application

name: AMT_APPLICATION
details: For how much credit did client ask on the previous application

name: AMT_CREDIT
details: Final credit amount on the previous application. This differs from AMT_APPLICATION in a way that the AMT_APPLICATION is the amount for which the client initially applied for, but during our approval process he could have received different amount - AMT_CREDIT

name: AMT_DOWN_PAYMENT
details: Down payment on the previous application

name: AMT_GOODS_PRICE
details: Goods price of good that client asked for (if applicable) on the previous application

name: WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START
details: On which day of the week did the client apply for previous application

name: HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START
details: Approximately at what day hour did the client apply for the previous application [Metadata note: rounded.]

name: FLAG_LAST_APPL_PER_CONTRACT
details: Flag if it was last application for the previous contract. Sometimes by mistake of client or our clerk there could be more applications for one single contract

name: NFLAG_LAST_APPL_IN_DAY
details: Flag if the application was the last application per day of the client. Sometimes clients apply for more applications a day. Rarely it could also be error in our system that one application is in the database twice

name: RATE_DOWN_PAYMENT
details: Down payment rate normalized on previous credit [Metadata note: normalized.]

name: RATE_INTEREST_PRIMARY
details: Interest rate normalized on previous credit [Metadata note: normalized.]

name: RATE_INTEREST_PRIVILEGED
details: Interest rate normalized on previous credit [Metadata note: normalized.]

name: NAME_CASH_LOAN_PURPOSE
details: Purpose of the cash loan

name: NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS
details: Contract status (approved, cancelled, ...) of previous application

name: DAYS_DECISION
details: Relative to current application when was the decision about previous application made [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: NAME_PAYMENT_TYPE
details: Payment method that client chose to pay for the previous application

name: CODE_REJECT_REASON
details: Why was the previous application rejected

name: NAME_TYPE_SUITE
details: Who accompanied client when applying for the previous application

name: NAME_CLIENT_TYPE
details: Was the client old or new client when applying for the previous application

name: NAME_GOODS_CATEGORY
details: What kind of goods did the client apply for in the previous application

name: NAME_PORTFOLIO
details: Was the previous application for CASH, POS, CAR, …

name: NAME_PRODUCT_TYPE
details: Was the previous application x-sell o walk-in

name: CHANNEL_TYPE
details: Through which channel we acquired the client on the previous application

name: SELLERPLACE_AREA
details: Selling area of seller place of the previous application

name: NAME_SELLER_INDUSTRY
details: The industry of the seller

name: CNT_PAYMENT
details: Term of previous credit at application of the previous application

name: NAME_YIELD_GROUP
details: Grouped interest rate into small medium and high of the previous application [Metadata note: grouped.]

name: PRODUCT_COMBINATION
details: Detailed product combination of the previous application

name: DAYS_FIRST_DRAWING
details: Relative to application date of current application when was the first disbursement of the previous application [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: DAYS_FIRST_DUE
details: Relative to application date of current application when was the first due supposed to be of the previous application [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: DAYS_LAST_DUE_1ST_VERSION
details: Relative to application date of current application when was the first due of the previous application [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: DAYS_LAST_DUE
details: Relative to application date of current application when was the last due date of the previous application [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: DAYS_TERMINATION
details: Relative to application date of current application when was the expected termination of the previous application [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: NFLAG_INSURED_ON_APPROVAL
details: Did the client requested insurance during the previous application
